record.body:
## Description

Update plan-phase, discuss, and execute-phase skills so deliver/repair work carries atomic requirement ids, acceptances are thin (no criterion prose), and executor briefs quote original record text.

## Approach

1. skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md: require atomic requirement ids on every deliver/repair work-item (description is the id'd list when no specification); one acceptance per id; ban compound ids; stop writing criterion prose (omit or empty once contract allows); replace omit-when-no-spec wording for requirements on deliver/repair; keep incidental exempt. Update create/capture examples.
2. skills/discuss/SKILL.md: atomic-id / split guidance for ## Requirements.
3. skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md: Orientation and brief rules quote work-item Description/Approach and requirement texts by id; do not paraphrase the claim; do not rely on criterion as the lead claim.
4. skills/verify-work/SKILL.md: only if wording still treats criterion prose as the claim — align to requirement id + original text.
5. Do not edit contract or tests here (owned by sibling tasks).

payload.title: Skills for atomic ids, thin acceptances, original briefs
